lines.zh: 我摆尾，顺着河岸的浅水游。
lines.en: I flick my tail along the shallows by the bank.

lines.zh: 只有半格长，石头都比我大。
lines.en: Half a block long. The stones are bigger than me.
Weeds brush my flank.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床游，慢慢往上走。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed, working upstream.
My fins open and close to hold steady.

lines.zh: 从红杉的影子里游到阳光下。
lines.en: From the redwood's shade into the sun.

lines.zh: 我绕开水流最急的那段。
lines.en: I avoid the fastest stretch.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍扫起河底的泥。
lines.en: My tail fin kicks up river mud.

lines.zh: 我朝水面游，看看有什么。
lines.en: I rise toward the surface to look.
I know this bank.
I swim through the cliff's reflection.

lines.zh: 水里有很多小东西在飘。
lines.en: Plenty of small things drifting in the water.
One roll of the body and I'm round the stone.
My fins paddle lightly.

lines.zh: 我游到林间空地的水湾。
lines.en: I reach the pool by the woodland clearing.

lines.zh: 水面上的亮光，一晃一晃。
lines.en: The light on the surface shifts and shifts.
I stop among the weeds and hold still.
The current pushes; I let it.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼，谁都能吃我。
lines.en: A fish this small could be eaten by anything.
I'm waiting for something to fall in.
I know every stone on this bottom.

lines.zh: 我在水草影里，一动不动。
lines.en: In the reed shade, I stay perfectly still.
Sunlight comes through the water onto my back.
I'm well hidden in the weeds.
Footsteps on the bank. I sink.
I know this river's taste.
Slow finbeats. Save strength.
The surface is too bright. I stay down.
A shadow passes over the bottom.
I'm counting today's insects.

lines.zh: 你在岸上蹲下，我停住尾鳍。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; my tail stops.
Seen from the water, you're all distorted.
Don't reach in. Any splash and I'm gone.
I'm too small for a meal.

lines.zh: 你的影子把水都遮暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow darkens the water.
I hover under your reflection.
I swim along the shadow on the riverbed.
I slip behind the stone.
Your face wobbles in the water.
I flick my tail and back away a little.
Water rushes through my torn fin, cold and numb.
I sink to the bottom and stay still.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，一下就见血。
lines.en: A body this small bleeds at one blow.
I hide in a gap between stones.

lines.zh: 血丝顺水飘走，我沉下去。
lines.en: Threads of blood drift off; I sink.
I can't swim, only drift.
I turned over and had to right myself.
A scale lifts; red seeps into the water.
When the current quickens, I can't hold steady.
I'm still afloat. Not sinking.

lines.zh: 水草擦过我的侧腹，我往上走。
lines.en: Weeds brush my flank as I move upriver.
I swim over and sniff at it.
Even that small a piece is worth a chase.
I swallow it whole. Barely tasted it.
The taste disperses fast in water.
I come back. Is there more?

lines.zh: 你撒的这点，不够一群鱼。
lines.en: That much won't feed a school.
I circle the surface twice.
This one's alive. Better.
Lower it slowly. Don't slap the water.
One bump and I rolled.

lines.zh: 你踩进水，我撞到你腿上。
lines.en: You stepped in and I hit your leg.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，撞了也没感觉。
lines.en: I'm so light you wouldn't feel the knock.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我就找不到方向。
lines.en: When the water clouds I lose direction.
I slip from your boot into deeper water.
Don't churn the water. I'll be swept off.
We touch and both stop.
I hurry into deeper water.
The stone is harder than you.
I flick back half a foot.
Swimming side by side is enough.
You're a stretch longer than me.
Among the weeds is a good place to hide.
Follow me upstream.

lines.zh: 这种水里，一辈子也不长。
lines.en: A life in this water isn't long.

lines.zh: 我们一起摆尾，水纹都一样。
lines.en: We beat our tails together, matching ripples.

lines.zh: 地狱溪的水浅，我贴着底。
lines.en: Hell Creek's water is shallow; I hug the bottom.
Eggs will settle in the weeds.
This river will remember us.
Let's go downstream together.
I take it in my mouth and test it.
Too heavy. I can't hold it.

lines.zh: 三点命的鱼，只能推一推。
lines.en: Three points, so all I do is nudge.
I nose a pebble aside.
I sweep it into the weeds.
A shell. Edible?
I swallow and it sticks.
What's on the bottom is mine.
Carrying it slows my swimming.
Even this makes a meal.
The ripples break; I turn at once.
I stop and only move my eyes.
Blood on the current.
I drift a little downstream.
That thing's far too big for me.
In the redwood river, I wait.
It's at the surface. I'm below.
I'll see which way it goes.
Fins tight. Still.
Wait for it to pass above.
The water moves; I sink.
It's gone. I come out.
I follow that shadow.
Each time it moves, the water sways.
I watch from behind a stone.
The current favors me.
It isn't watching the bottom.

lines.zh: 我顺着水草根，慢慢贴过去。
lines.en: I creep along the reed roots.

lines.zh: 它的影子盖住我了，红杉林的浅水太清。
lines.en: Its shadow covers me; the redwood shallows are clear.
I stop. Wait for it to move again.
My fins tremble. I hold them still.

lines.zh: 我再贴近一点，水纹更小。
lines.en: One more inch, and my wake shrinks.

lines.zh: 水草在动，是我们的动静。
lines.en: The weeds sway. That's us.
It turned. I sink down.
Water under the redwoods is coolest.
I dart in and bite.
Small teeth. Only soft things.
Bite, then straight into the weeds.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，水花打在你腿上。
lines.en: My tail sweeps; water sprays your leg.
That much strength. One blow only.
It slaps a hand into the water.
The water's churned blind.
I dodged, but I'm badly startled.
Holding on is too much risk.
I let go and dive deep.
That lunge was all I had.
After that bite, I'm still alive.

lines.zh: 从水草里钻出来，水还没干。
lines.en: Out of the weeds, still wet.
The water's cold. The bank looms overhead.
I'm only half a block long.

lines.zh: 红杉的影子落在水面上。
lines.en: Redwood shadows fall on the water.
I circle the stone once.
Insects land on the surface; I rise for them.
I head for the shallows.
The light on the surface is bright.
Something's walking up there.
I sink to the bottom and wait.
In this river I'm not big.
I flick my tail and head upstream.
Water drips from the cliff.
Food first, down on this riverbed.

lines.zh: 水一下变烫，我拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The water turned hot. I dive for depth.

lines.zh: 我从水皮上跌下去，砸在河床。
lines.en: I dropped off the surface onto the riverbed.
The water's too shallow. I can't breathe.
The blast filled the water with silt.
Something punched through my side.
That light spread through the water, stinging.

lines.zh: 水里的虫子都没了，我越来越轻。
lines.en: The insects are gone. I grow lighter and lighter.

lines.zh: 地狱溪的河湾，我绕惯了。
lines.en: I know every bend of Hell Creek.
No water here. My gills gape.
